claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise these as great value, noting they are cheaper than brand-name alternatives and come in a large quantity.
Many buyers use them as disposable tester applicators for their LipSense/SeneGence cosmetics business and find them effective for sampling without contamination.
The small angled tip allows precise application and works well for lipstick, gloss, and layering products.
Some note the quality is slightly below the original bottle wand, though acceptable for one-time use.
A few reviewers report issues such as product absorbing into the wand or poor spreading.
